title: Insurance Contracts
summary: Remains converged with IFRS 4 (the interim global standard), not IFRS 17. India has not yet notified an Ind AS 117 equivalent; Indian insurers prepare statements under IRDAI's framework, with Ind AS 104 governing limited insurance contract disclosures for non-insurance entities.

bannerNotice.title: Ind AS — A Notable Time-Lag from Global IFRS
bannerNotice.body: Ind AS 104 remains converged with IFRS 4 (the INTERIM global standard), NOT IFRS 17 (which has replaced IFRS 4 globally since 2023). India has NOT yet notified an Ind AS 117 equivalent, and Indian insurance companies continue to prepare financial statements primarily under IRDAI's own regulatory framework, with Ind AS 104 governing the LIMITED insurance contract disclosures relevant to non-insurance entities. Section 11 covers this important divergence in full.
